thread:
Priya: heads up  early UX signoff requests to include per-tenant routing preferences in MVP. Engineering says it adds surface area and could delay. We need a cut decision: ship slim routing controls or ship none and add in v1.
Marcus: what's the exact ask from UX? full routing UI or just boolean 'prefer dedicated'?
Priya: initial ask is two toggles: 'prefer-latency' and 'prefer-cost'. Backend needs per-tenant routing hint support, persistence, and enforcement.
Rina: backend complexity: add a small routing_hint field in tenant config + routing layer read. Enforcement is lightweight; the heavier work is UI & audit logs.
Tess: options: 1) only backend support (APIs + config) with no UI for MVP, 2) full UI + audit logs (v1), 3) defer entirely and surface as advanced beta later.
Ibrahim: effort: 1) ~5 eng-days, 2) ~12 eng-days, 3) 0 days but product backlog increase.
Priya: constraint: feature-freeze in 4 days. If we do 1 we can include API + flag and leave UI for v1. If 2 we slip ~1 week.
Marcus: customer pilots expect routing toggles in console. Might disappoint them if no UI, but API-only is usable through infra.
Rina: proposal: do option 1 (API + persistent routing hint) and produce a short docs + CLI snippet for pilots to set preferences. Add UI as v1.
Tess: will draft the docs and CLI snippet. Also propose a small telemetry field to track usage of routing hint.
Ibrahim: will add routing_hint field and tests.
ops-bot: lint checks queued for PR.
Priya: approvals? @Marcus @Rina
Marcus: +1, but add a quick UX placeholder in console that links to docs so pilots have a path.
Rina: +1. Will add telemetry metric routing_hint_used_count.
Priya: actions: Ibrahim  API + tests (due: 2026-04-01), Tess  docs + CLI snippet + UX placeholder (due: 2026-03-30), Marcus  pilot comms (due: 2026-04-01). I'll update milestone and mark full routing UI for v1.
Priya: thanks, closing the loop. :rocket:
